name: Calendar
description:
A month grid for picking a day or a range. Arrow keys move by day and week, Home and
End go to the week's ends, Page Up and Page Down change month (with Shift, year), and
Enter or Space picks. In range mode the first pick sets the start and the second the
end; the days between show as a band while you choose. Names and the first day of the
week come from the locale.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the active day on mount (popovers).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: Any day in the month to show first (default: the value, else today).

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for names and the first day of the week (default en-AU).

props.name: max
props.description: Upper value or visible-item limit, as specified by the type.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when value change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: today
props.description: The day marked as today (default: the user's local day).

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.
